result.instructions: Tools for Codemagic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Did my latest app build succeed or fail?"; "List the last 10 builds across all my apps."; "Get me a download link for the newest build's output file.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Codemagic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run codemagic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run codemagic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run codemagic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. codemagic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: codemagic_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List all applications (apps) in the Codemagic account, with their ids, names, and workflow ids. Codemagic REST: GET /apps.

tools.name: codemagic_get_application
tools.title: Get application
tools.description: Get a single application (app) by id. Codemagic REST: GET /apps/{id}.

tools.name: codemagic_list_builds
tools.title: List builds
tools.description: List builds, optionally filtered by application, workflow, and/or branch. Codemagic REST: GET /builds.

appId.description: Restrict to builds for this application id.

workflowId.description: Restrict to builds for this workflow id.

branch.description: Restrict to builds for this branch.

tools.name: codemagic_get_build
tools.title: Get build
tools.description: Get a single build by id, including its status. Codemagic REST: GET /builds/{id}.

tools.name: codemagic_list_caches
tools.title: List caches
tools.description: List the build caches for an application (id, size, last used, workflow). Codemagic REST: GET /apps/{appId}/caches.

tools.name: codemagic_get_artifact_download_url
tools.title: Get artifact download URL
tools.description: Get an authenticated download URL for a build artifact by its secure filename (from a build's artifacts list). Codemagic REST: GET /artifacts/{secureFilename}.

secureFilename.description: The secure filename/path of the artifact (from a build's artifacts list).

tools.name: codemagic_start_build
tools.title: Start build
tools.description: Start a new build for an application workflow. `appId` and `workflowId` are required; optionally target a branch or tag and pass environment/labels/instanceType. Codemagic REST: POST /builds.

tag.description: The tag to build (alternative to branch).

environment.description: Environment overrides for this build (variables, groups, etc.).

labels.description: Labels to attach to this build.

instanceType.description: The build machine instance type (e.g. mac_mini_m2, linux_x2).

tools.name: codemagic_cancel_build
tools.title: Cancel build
tools.description: Cancel a running build by id. Codemagic REST: POST /builds/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: codemagic_create_artifact_public_url
tools.title: Create artifact public URL
tools.description: Create a public (shareable, time-limited) download URL for a build artifact by its secure filename. Codemagic REST: POST /artifacts/{secureFilename}/public-url.

secureFilename.description: The secure filename/path of the artifact (from a build's artifacts list).

expiresAt.description: When the public URL should expire, as a UNIX timestamp in SECONDS.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Codemagic
prompts.description: What you can do with Codemagic here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_whether_the_latest_build_succeeded
prompts.title: Check whether the latest build succeeded
prompts.description: The AI lists builds, filtered by app, workflow or branch, and opens one build to read its status. You see what passed or failed and on which branch.

prompts.name: list_your_apps_and_their_build_workflows
prompts.title: List your apps and their build workflows
prompts.description: The AI lists all apps in the account with their ids, names and workflow ids, and can open a single app. You can see which workflows exist for each app.

prompts.name: review_the_build_caches_of_an_app
prompts.title: Review the build caches of an app
prompts.description: The AI lists the caches of an app with their id, size, last used date and workflow, so you can see which caches are large or unused.

prompts.name: get_or_share_a_download_link_for_a_build_file
prompts.title: Get or share a download link for a build file
prompts.description: The AI reads a build's artifacts and gets a private download link for a file. It can also create a public, time-limited link that you can share.

prompts.name: start_a_build_for_a_branch_or_tag
prompts.title: Start a build for a branch or tag
prompts.description: The AI starts a build for an app and workflow on the branch or tag you name. You can also pass environment variables, labels and an instance type.

prompts.name: cancel_a_running_build
prompts.title: Cancel a running build
prompts.description: The AI finds a running build and cancels it, for example when you pushed the wrong branch or a build is stuck.
